notes.body: Is this true with the new `ws_error()`?
Yes it is true, ws_error() aborts [here](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/wsutil/wslog.c#L402).
I haven't looked at the details yet, but are we now able to get a "console" with log messages on all platforms? I'm thinking about the `gui.console_open: AUTOMATIC` preference.
No, the behavior is the same as before. The console only pops-up on Windows (and that preference is only used on Windows too).

I don't think there are APIs to do that on other platforms (pop-up a console), but we don't need them anyway, I think we could easily use a graphical UI for that instead, like popping open a Qt textview window, or something like that.
